note: Both sets capture the ~100 issues/concerns from the initial LCIT reviews of the Draft Final Reports across the four mission concepts, with a supporting quote. Set A adds a third claim binding the value 100 to 'mission concepts | quantity', which the page does not support and which misreads the sentence. Set B omits that invented claim but repeats the same fact twice (once misbound to 'Draft Final Reports | number of findings'), so it is cleaner but redundant. Both sets leave out the qualitative process facts (STDT modifications, feedback per finding, reduction of remaining issues).
remarks: The claim 'Draft Final Reports | number of findings | 100' appears in both sets and is misbound: the ~100 issues resulted from the LCIT reviews, not from the reports themselves; its quote is also a truncated fragment. Both sets miss the remaining process facts on the slide (STDT modifications before public release, per-finding feedback and change references, and the significant reduction of remaining issues), which are qualitative rather than numeric.
